purpose: A transparent, deterministic showcase of SkillScout's native-first decision behavior. These examples are not telemetry or model-quality benchmarks.

cases.request: Rewrite this customer email so it is concise and calm.
cases.first_action: Read the supplied email and draft a concise rewrite.
cases.reason: The request is self-contained writing; no external system is needed.

cases.request: Fix this issue in my repository and open a pull request.
cases.first_action: Inspect the repository, current branch, and issue context.
cases.reason: The repository and pull request are required work surfaces.

cases.request: Implement this Figma screen in React and prepare the GitHub delivery path.
cases.first_action: Read the Figma design context before changing code.
cases.reason: Design context is required first; GitHub becomes necessary only for delivery.

cases.request: Compare the current pricing plans of these services.
cases.first_action: Find and read the current official pricing pages.

cases.request: Analyze our internal usage table and recommend the next retention experiment.
cases.first_action: Confirm the source, metric definitions, and read permission before querying data.
cases.reason: A private data source is indispensable and must be handled with explicit access boundaries.
